caption: Mount Olympus, Litochoro
composition: Rocky path toward Stefani and Mytikas · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the summit approach above the Plateau of the Muses, a cairned path of bare limestone leads toward the amphitheater of Stefani and the higher summit of Mytikas. The night is mainly clear, about -2.4°C at the high model cell, with a light wind and no precipitation. The south faces are in moonlight. No snowfield was added, because the model did not report snow.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Mount Olympus summit approach at night
approval_basis: Night view of Mount Olympus from Litochoro: jagged grey limestone summit crags rise under a near-full moon at upper left with stars visible, wind-torn cloud veiling the peaks, and stone cairns in the rocky foreground — the Throne-of-Zeus high massif atmosphere, recognizable Olympus character. Technical: masters at exact 1920x1080 / 864x1080 (sweep-verified); on-image caption 'Mount Olympus, Litochoro', scenario '24 September 2026 · 03:19 Europe/Athens', AI disclosure and exact 'Jason D's Vision' signature legible on the bottom gradient. Gate 2 weather: note cites its own Open-Meteo fetch, retrieved 2026-09-25T21:44:02Z — repo-wide unique, separate request for 40.085,22.359, scenario 03:19 inside the 03:15 model-valid hour, mainly-clear/35% cloud/-2.3°C at ~2776m model elevation consistent with the cloud-veiled moonlit peaks shown. Gate 3: text-prompt-only lineage. Gate 4: no people, no logos. 5/5.

qc_notes.note: Approval withdrawn 2026-09-25 (Cosmo QC): the weather metadata was a shared/batch Open-Meteo retrieval (retrieval timestamp 2026-09-24T00:17:07Z identical across 16 scenes), failing Gate 2 under the confirmed standing policy — one HTTP fetch per scene, one recorded retrieval timestamp per scene; identical-to-the-second timestamps across scenes = shared retrieval. Rework: fetch Open-Meteo fresh per scene (own HTTP request, own recorded timestamp), scenario hour inside the model-valid hour; update the approvals note with the new retrieval evidence; re-push masters only if on-image text must change. Scene stays Candidate until Cosmo QC re-audits.
